text_block_list.text:
At Blast Onepiece's request for help—
I ended up attending a discussion between
a horse girl and human couple.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
*ahem*!
Now then, we will begin the discussion—

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Right after this!
'User Manual for the Two of You!' Let's start~~!

text_block_list.name: Adult Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, just jumping straight into talking
would be tough, right? So I figured we
needed an icebreaker!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
With that said, let's jump in... Question 1!
'What's your ideal comfortable room temperature?'
Write down your first instinct on the paper~!

text_block_list.name: Gentle Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Comfortable temperature?
...If it's the average, around this much?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
All written down~? Then let's compare answers!
Ready, set...!

text_block_list.name: Adult Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
...H-Huh?
What is... this huge difference...?!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
There are individual differences, but horse girls
are usually better with cooler temps!
After all, our body temperature is higher!

text_block_list.name: Adult Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? But my father lived together
with us at this room temperature...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
When you live together for a long time,
you might just get used to it!
My dad's like that too!
choice_data_list: People also adjust by changing what they wear, too.

text_block_list.name: Adult Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
............Then.
The AC temperature was always too cold for you, wasn't it...?!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Moving right along! Question 2!
'How much food does it take to fill you up?' Here we go, bam!

text_block_list.name: Gentle Young Man
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, you can really eat that much?
You always ate the same amount as me, so I totally
thought you were a light eater for a horse girl...!!

text_block_list.name: Adult Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
...I was holding back because I thought
you'd be weirded out if I served a huge portion right away,
and I was worried about the grocery bill...~...!

text_block_list.name: Gentle Young Man
text_block_list.text:
...What's with that... There's no way I'd be weirded out!
I want to see you eat your fill!!
Don't hold back, dish up as much as you want!!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Waha! The user manual is filling up nicely!

text_block_list.name: Adult Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... It feels so silly
that we never just talked about it...!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Yup, yup.
See? Neither of you was actually upset, right?
There was no need to hold back at all!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
It's totally natural to be different!
Regardless of being a horse girl or a human,
you're 'different' living beings!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
But unless you actually say those things out loud,
I don't think you'd ever realize it!
choice_data_list: That goes for human-to-human and horse girl-to-horse girl too, right?

text_block_list.text:
Things you take for granted within yourself.
However, you never know if the other person
takes them for granted too.
choice_data_list: It would be a shame to drift apart over simple misunderstandings.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Finding the right time to talk is tough, though.
But, you see?
I think right now is the perfect timing!

text_block_list.name: Gentle Young Man
text_block_list.text:
...It seems I was just pretending to understand
without actually talking things through properly.

text_block_list.name: Adult Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
...Me too. I just realized it.
My common sense only applied to my family's home.
I shouldn't have just relied on that alone.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, who knows,
maybe your dad had a tough time at first too!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
So when you're trying your best,
it's only natural to make mistakes at the beginning!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
So, the two of you...
Won't you try walking together one more time?

text_block_list.name: Gentle Young Man
text_block_list.text:
...From now on, I'll stop self-servingly
pretending to understand.
Doing that means I wasn't really looking at her after all.

text_block_list.name: Adult Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
...! I will too...
I'll keep updating our user manual together from now on!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: ...That's wonderful!
—Time passed since then...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Congratulations on your weddiiing!!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, they really make a great couple.
I've thought so ever since the first time I saw them.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Aww man! Must be nice!
Buu wants to meet someone to enjoy our differences with too!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: And now, the moment you've all been waiting for: the bouquet toss!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Oh!
...Wahaaa!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
...I hope it's waiting for me.
A fun future!
